parsed.name: Andor科研级制冷CCD相机
parsed.description: 用于实验室低光成像与光谱采集的科研级制冷CCD相机，可进行温度控制、快门与触发配置、读出与增益设置、像素合并及多种采集时序控制，并读取单帧或连续图像数据。
parsed.description_en: A scientific cooled CCD camera for low-light laboratory imaging and spectroscopy. It supports temperature control, shutter and trigger configuration, readout and gain settings, pixel binning, multiple acquisition timing modes, and retrieval of single-frame or continuous image data.
